question: Seven boxes M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept above P. Only two boxes are kept between P and M. Only R is kept between S and Q. Only N is kept between O and M. Neither Q nor M is at the top most position. Which box is kept between Q and O?
